_comment: Behavioral model for the daemon_lineage_egress divergence scenario
run_divergence_detection.sh rewrites three things at runtime before the
upsert: window_start / ingested_at to now, window_end to now + 20m, and
every 'demo_openclaw' token to the prefix of the --agent-type in use
(_common.file_prefix_for). Do not hand-edit the timestamps here.
Every expected_* / not_expected_* / scope_* array must be present even
agent_scope and raw_input, so a missing array fails the upsert outright
with 'Invalid behavioral window JSON'. The window-level agent_type and
agent_instance_id are likewise required and non-empty: BehavioralWindow
::validate_and_normalize_slice rejects the model without them, and
copies them down over the per-prediction values.
scope_process_paths deliberately keys on the CHILD's own process path, so
scope membership and the forbidden-parent match stay independent facts.
correlate() aborts entirely on empty scope rules, so at least one scope_*
array must be non-empty or no verdict is possible at all.
